title: Vacuum pump having expansion chamber and method of achieving ultimate pressure state in a vacuum pump using an expansion chamber

features.item: cordless handheld vacuum lifting device with integrated battery power
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum pump system, but not a cordless handheld lifting device with integrated battery power.

features.item: flexible sealing lip on suction cup that bounds sealed region against workpiece
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum pump and its components, but not a suction cup with a flexible sealing lip.

features.item: electric vacuum pump mounted within rigid body to draw air from sealed region
features.quote: a vacuum pump 1 to which the present invention can be applied includes a housing 100, and a pump head 200 and a pump motor 300 disposed in the housing 100.
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum pump with a pump head and motor disposed within a housing, which can be considered a rigid body.
features.refuted: The quote describes the components of a vacuum pump but does not mention it being electric, mounted within a rigid body, or drawing air from a sealed region.

features.item: pressure sensor monitoring vacuum level in sealed region
features.quote: Furthermore, the vacuum scroll pump 1 and/or system 2 may comprise a controller 1000 and at least one pressure sensor for sensing the pressure at a location within the vacuum scroll pump 1 and/or system 2.
features.note: The reference explicitly states the presence of a pressure sensor for monitoring pressure within the vacuum pump system.
features.refuted: The quote states a pressure sensor senses pressure within the vacuum scroll pump or system, not specifically in a 'sealed region' as asserted.

features.item: warning indicator activated when vacuum falls to threshold above release vacuum level
features.note: The reference discusses monitoring pressure and controlling pump operation, but does not describe a warning indicator activated based on a vacuum threshold above a release level.

features.item: warning threshold defined relative to load-release vacuum rather than working vacuum
features.note: The reference does not discuss warning thresholds or load-release vacuum.

features.item: warning indicator remains active while grip vacuum persists below threshold
features.note: The reference does not discuss warning indicators or their persistence.

features.item: rechargeable battery integrated into rigid body powering vacuum pump
features.note: The reference mentions an electric motor for the pump but does not specify a rechargeable battery integrated into a rigid body for power.

features.item: warning indicator positioned on rigid body for visibility during lifting operation
features.note: The reference does not describe any warning indicators or their placement for visibility during lifting operations.

features.item: single-hand portable design with all components carried by rigid body without external hose or cord
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum pump system, but not a single-hand portable design without external hoses or cords.

overall.why: The reference describes a vacuum pump system with pressure monitoring and control, which is broadly related to the subject invention's field of vacuum technology, but lacks specific features related to handheld lifting devices, sealing lips, warning indicators, or integrated battery power.
